## Lead feeds → JobRadar
Every hour: Jobgether (remote-friendly roles by country, its official API for agents). Every 3 hours: the job sitemaps of European VC portfolio boards (Point Nine, Atomico, Speedinvest, Earlybird …). New listings whose title you want go to the radar like LinkedIn alerts do. Switch off in settings.json: "boards": { "jobgether": false, "getro": false }.

nodes.name: 🌐 Fetch feeds
nodes.notes: One request every 2 s (Jobgether asks for a 2-second crawl delay)
